title: npcHouse
body:
Elder Wren: Welcome to Saltford, traveller. I'm Wren, the elder of this village.

[[Ask about the village|npcHouseKyla]]
[[Say goodbye|npcHouseHyvasti]]

title: npcHouseKyla
body:
Elder Wren: Saltford is a quiet fishing village. Most of us have lived by the sea all our lives.
Elder Wren: The road through the south gate leads down to the beach.

[[Say goodbye|npcHouseHyvasti]]

title: npcBeach
body: Stranger: Hello there. The sea breeze is lovely today.
